WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT c.location, COUNT(*) as city_count 
  FROM qualifying q 
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId 
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId 
  GROUP BY c.location
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(city_count) as overall_average 
  FROM city_counts
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT cc.city_count, cc.city_count - oa.overall_average as difference
  FROM city_counts cc
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE cc.city_count > oa.overall_average
)
SELECT 
  AVG(kept_groups.city_count) as avg_kept_counts,
  AVG(kept_groups.difference) as avg_differences
FROM kept_groups
